```artifact
Feature: System Backup and User Authentication

  Scenario: Nightly system backup rotation
  Given the system is operational at the end of the day
  When the backup process is initiated
  Then the backup files should be stored at the remote site
  And the backup files should be rotated every 30 days

  Scenario Outline: Backup rotation with examples
  | Backup type | Rotation period | Expected result                                  |
  | Full       | 30 days        | Backup files stored and rotated correctly             |
  | Full       | 60 days        | Backup files stored but not rotated correctly       |
  | Incremental| 30 days        | Incremental backup files stored and rotated correctly |
  | Incremental| 60 days        | Incremental backup files stored but not rotated correctly |

  Scenario: User credential change
  Given a user is authenticated
  When the user changes their credentials
  Then the system should accept the new credentials

  Scenario Outline: Credential change with examples
  | User type | Credential change | Expected result                                  |
  | Doctor    | Password change    | Credentials accepted and updated                     |
  | Chemist   | Password change    | Credentials accepted and updated                     |
  | Lab       | Password change    | Credentials accepted and updated                     |
  | Patient   | User-id creation    | User-id and password created and accepted           |

  Scenario: Report generation
  Given the system is operational
  When the report generation is requested
  Then the system should generate the requested report

  Scenario Outline: Report generation with examples
  | Report type                   | Expected result                                  |
  | Doctor wise Appointment file | Next 5 days appointments                         |
  | Speciality wise Consultations | Last day of the month consultations                 |
  | Speciality wise Revenue | Last day of the month revenue                     |

```
